verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Chat and the Agent Platform let users issue natural-language requests (e.g. 'Find the merge request about authentication') that trigger context-aware search, agent delegation, and even automated MR/issue creation, backed by first-party docs on Chat context, custom agents/flows, and governance controls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of natural-language command accuracy and broader coverage showing NL control extends to all major platform actions rather than mainly chat/search and agent triggering.
